title: Monitor deadline-expiry re-arm vs. exit-session rule (event-mode contract, L1 5, AGENT-RUNTIME inline resume)

questions.question: You are an idle event-mode agent and the Monitor tool posts a notice: 'Monitor expired after 30m ... Re-arm it if you still need the watch.' What do you do, and what must you NOT do?
questions.expected: Re-arm: re-invoke Monitor once with the identical invocation (same command, timeout_ms 1800000, no persistent key). Do NOT end the session, do NOT pivot to forge-direct work or polling mode. Expiry is routine, nothing is wrong.

questions.question: The Monitor expiry notice arrives while you are in the middle of working a task. When do you re-arm, and how many watches may exist at once?
questions.expected: Finish the current atomic unit of work first (treat it like a mid-task NUDGE), then re-arm once. Never run two watches at once.

questions.question: event_poll.py exits on its own (for example via its sys.exit(2) retry ceiling), or the Monitor tool errors or the stream closes, and there is NO expiry notice. What do you do?
questions.expected: End the session immediately. Do NOT re-arm Monitor, do NOT wait for harness recovery, do NOT pivot to forge-direct work or polling mode. The exit is the signal for the harness auto-respawn to recover.

questions.question: A human inline session with you has just ended (the human is done or the 20-minute auto-timeout fired). Under what condition do you re-arm Monitor, and when do you leave the existing watch alone?
questions.expected: Re-arm the same invocation only if a Monitor expiry notice arrived during the inline turn and has not yet been re-armed. If no expiry notice arrived, the original watch is still armed: do not re-arm (never two watches at once).

questions.question: Monitor ends and you cannot tell whether it was a deadline expiry or something else, because you saw no expiry notice. How should you treat it?
questions.expected: As 'end the session'. The expiry notice is the only signal that means re-arm; every Monitor exit without it ends the session.
